blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Вот куда ___ (вести — to lead, take along, one way; impf., past n. sg.)!
exercises.why: **вело** — past tense (neuter) of вести: one-direction verb (many directions: водить).

exercises.q: А ___ (везти — to convey by vehicle, one way; impf., pres. 1st sg.) в лес.
exercises.why: **везу** — present tense (1st person singular) of везти: one-direction verb (many directions: возить).

exercises.q: В штаб ___ (везти — to convey by vehicle, one way; impf., inf.)?.
Я ___ (нести — to carry on foot, one way; impf., pres. 1st sg.) ей работу.
exercises.why: **несу** — present tense (1st person singular) of нести: one-direction verb (many directions: носить).

exercises.q: Их ___ (вести — to lead, take along, one way; impf., past m. sg.) Рощин.
exercises.why: **вел** — past tense (masculine) of вести: one-direction verb (many directions: водить).

exercises.q: Вина не ___ (везти — to convey by vehicle, one way; impf., pres. 2nd pl.)?
exercises.why: **везете** — present tense (2nd person plural) of везти: one-direction verb (many directions: возить).

exercises.q: Не хошь ___ (везти — to convey by vehicle, one way; impf., inf.)?
Куда вас ___ (везти — to convey by vehicle, one way; impf., pres. 3rd pl.)?
exercises.why: **везут** — present tense (3rd person plural) of везти: one-direction verb (many directions: возить).

exercises.q: ___ (везти — to convey by vehicle, one way; impf., past m. sg.) ведь как!
exercises.why: **вез** — past tense (masculine) of везти: one-direction verb (many directions: возить).

exercises.q: Они ___ (нести — to carry on foot, one way; impf., past pl.) ему обед.
exercises.why: **несли** — past tense (plural) of нести: one-direction verb (many directions: носить).

exercises.q: А ___ (везти — to convey by vehicle, one way; impf., pres. 2nd sg.) солому?
exercises.why: **везешь** — present tense (2nd person singular) of везти: one-direction verb (many directions: возить).

exercises.q: Начало мы ___ (вести — to lead, take along, one way; impf., pres. 1st pl.)!
exercises.why: **ведем** — present tense (1st person plural) of вести: one-direction verb (many directions: водить).

exercises.q: Куда же их ___ (вести — to lead, take along, one way; impf., pres. 3rd pl.)?
exercises.why: **ведут** — present tense (3rd person plural) of вести: one-direction verb (many directions: водить).

exercises.q: Ну что ж, ___ (везти — to convey by vehicle, one way; impf., imper. sg.)!
exercises.why: **вези** — imperative (ты, singular) of везти: one-direction verb (many directions: возить).

exercises.q: Шубу-то зачем ___ (нести — to carry on foot, one way; impf., pres. 2nd sg.)?
exercises.why: **несешь** — present tense (2nd person singular) of нести: one-direction verb (many directions: носить).

exercises.q: ___ (нести — to carry on foot, one way; impf., pres. 1st pl.) в скудельницу!
exercises.why: **несем** — present tense (1st person plural) of нести: one-direction verb (many directions: носить).

exercises.q: Кто идёт, что ___ (нести — to carry on foot, one way; impf., pres. 3rd sg.)?
exercises.why: **несёт** — present tense (3rd person singular) of нести: one-direction verb (many directions: носить).

exercises.q: Вокруг ___ (нести — to carry on foot, one way; impf., past pl.) факелы.
exercises.why: **несли** — past tense (plural) of нести: one-direction verb (many directions: носить).

exercises.q: Их ___ (вести — to lead, take along, one way; impf., past pl.) убивать.
exercises.why: **вели** — past tense (plural) of вести: one-direction verb (many directions: водить).
